definitions.revenueDefinition: Signed portal total plus billing journal Omzet and Doorberekende kosten accounts; cents. Microfas representative uses current assignment.
definitions.balanceDefinition: Open balance per invoice from the Microfas open-item status on the debtors account 132000 (status 0 = open, 10 = matched), so credit notes matched to an invoice settle it. Invoices from 7 April 2026; amounts EXCLUDING VAT (VAT share exact per invoice; items without invoice lines use the customer's own VAT ratio, else its market's). Older balances and unmatched cash are listed as other open items. Due date = invoice date + the customer's current payment terms. Tie-out: open items excl. VAT + VAT in them + matched items that do not net to zero = account 132000.
definitions.vatDefinition: All amounts in this dataset exclude VAT: revenue, receivables, payments, open balances, margins and the books. VAT appears only in *InclVat reference fields used to reconcile with the debtors ledger.
definitions.orderDefinition: Current header status before invoiced; schedule relative to extract. stage: invoiced (order number already on an invoiced delivery; status not closed), noLines (open header without any order lines), deliveredNotInvoiced (all lines delivered, no invoice yet), toDeliver (quantity outstanding). Historical backlog requires archived snapshots.
definitions.timeDefinition: ISO weeks. Portal day/week unavailable. Filter null buckets when presenting daily detail and state coverage.
definitions.attributionDefinition: All months use the product's current Microfas category and the customer's current verkoper; portal labels are kept in categoryOriginal and verkoperOriginal.
definitions.marginDefinition: Estimated gross margin = revenue - kg x purchase price (price list named inkoop) valid at the invoice date; only products and days with a purchase price. Freight, discounts and stock effects not included.
definitions.booksDefinition: All P&L postings by month and account, income positive. The books start on the first day of the month of the first billing in Microfas (1 April 2026); costs dated 1-7 April are included because that week's deliveries were invoiced from 8 April. A few postings are back-dated before it and are excluded. Purchases are booked when bought, not when sold; no stock-change postings exist, so monthly results swing with purchase timing.
definitions.contractDefinition: Delivered kg of the contract product group to the contract customer within the term; portal months count only when the whole month lies in the term.
definitions.volumeDefinition: kg for products sold by weight, microPieces/1e6 for products sold per piece, net of returns. Product lines may overlap; never add lines together.
